fields.title: 📖 The Messenger ﷺ explains the Qurʾān
fields.body:
🖋️ **Allah ʿazza wa jalla:**

> ***“Allah sent down the Reminder to the Messenger ﷺ so that he might explain to the people what was sent down to them.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Therefore the Ḥukm is not separated from the Qurʾān, and the Sunnah is not set aside. Both are the standard.

immutable.source: 📝 aṭ-Ṭabarī und Ibn Kathīr, Tafsīr zu Sūrah an-Naḥl 16:44.
